_comment: How a voyage leg was travelled. One catalogue read by BOTH the map renderer (resources/js/timemap/voyage-ships.js) and the wizard's per-leg picker (App\Livewire\Wizard\Step3SceneConfigurator), so adding a model here puts it in the picker and on the map at once. `terrain` splits the collection the picker offers: a sea leg is shown ships, a land leg is shown mounts. The id 'sea' is the default for any leg that does not say how it travelled. Thumbnails are rendered from the models themselves by tools/render_transport_thumbs.py.
